rooms.name: An Immortal Map Room
rooms.desc: An undone immortal map room.

rooms.name: In the Lava
rooms.desc:
You can't walk on lava! Good job, not only have you gotten yourself killed,
but your equipment has been melted as well!

rooms.name: At the Top of the Volcano
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the peak of what appears to be an active volcano, if the
pool of lava to your southeast is any indication. Down from here, the slope
of the volcano leads to a verdant jungle which sprawls from the volcano's
base. In all directions, except for the distant northwest, the jungle
continues until is almost seems to flow into the ocean. Far to the northwest,
you can see a clearing between the jungle and the ocean, along with a small
village. To the east and south, you can continue to walk around the pool of
lava.

rooms.desc:
You are standing on the northwest slope of a volcano. The mixture of igneous
rock and volcanic ask beneath your feet forms a rugged traveling surface.
Down the slope, to your north and west, a verdant jungle sprawls from the
volcano's base. Up the slope, you can see steam and smoke rising from the
mouth of the volcano.
